payroll.label: Median of the annual total compensation of all our employees (other than the CEO), 2025 fiscal year

source.label: 2026 proxy statement, CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: the median of the annual total compensation of all our employees (other than the CEO) was $93,397;

notes: Employees: year-end count stated in thousands in the FY2025 10-K (169 thousand; 87 thousand in the U.S.). Payroll: the FY2025 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (ratio 295 to 1). Ford may use the same median employee for three years under SEC rules; the proxy says it does not believe its employee population or compensation arrangements changed in a way that would significantly change the ratio.
